verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing on model-based end-of-turn detection, semantic turn-taking, or tuning endpointing beyond VAD silence timeouts. The barge-in evidence (docs-8, docs-19) covers the user interrupting the agent, not the agent deciding when the user has finished speaking, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers
